title: Fashion Victim
overview: HOLY SHIT! Now this was some weird stuff. This film by Maxx Ginnane from Australia proves unequivocally that they are less inhibited down-unda than they are in Utah. There was a ton of gore, wacky-insane lesbians pissing on the street, togas, etc. I pretty much couldn't believe what I was watching for 23 minutes. Truly a worthy entry for TromaDance. (I am not making any of this up.)
